title: Troy
content: Inspired by Homer's 'Iliad,' the film depicts the legendary Trojan War, a conflict sparked by the forbidden love between Paris of Troy and Helen of Sparta. As mighty warriors clash and empires are tested, the story unfolds with themes of honor, fate, and the cost of glory. The epic tale brings to life some of history's most iconic figures, including Achilles, Hector, and Agamemnon.
